message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a rich, moist chocolate cake. Feel free to adjust quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or a splash of orange liqueur) to suit your taste. | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake, 2 layers) | Notes | |------------|----------------------------------------------|-------| | **All‑purpose flour** | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted; use cake flour for an even lighter crumb. | | **Cocoa powder** | ¾ cup (65 g) | Unsweetened, Dutch‑processed or natural – choose based on flavor preference. | | **Granulated sugar** | 2 cups (400 g) | White or a mix of white + brown for extra depth. | | **Baking powder** | 1 ½ tsp | Helps the cake rise. | | **Baking soda** | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for lift. | | **Salt** | 1 tsp | Balances sweetness. | | **Eggs** | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion. | | **Whole milk** | 1 cup (240 ml) | Or buttermilk for tanginess. | | **Vegetable oil** | ½ cup (120 ml) | Neutral‑flavored; can swap for melted butter for richer taste. | | **Vanilla extract** | 2 tsp | Adds aroma. | | **Boiling water** | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa, keeps batter thin. | | **Optional extras** | | • 1 tsp espresso powder (enhances chocolate flavor)
• ¼ cup chocolate chips or chopped nuts (for texture)
• 1 tbsp liqueur (e.g., Grand Marnier) for a subtle twist | **Basic Steps:** 1. Preheat oven to 350 °F (175 °C). Grease and flour two 9‑inch round pans (or line with parchment). 2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. 3. Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla; beat on medium speed until smooth. 4. Stir in boiling water (batter will be thin). 5. Pour evenly into prepared pans. 6. Bake 30–35 min, or until a toothpick comes out clean. 7. Cool in pans 10 min, then transfer to wire racks to cool completely before frosting. Enjoy your chocolate cake!
